description: Auth Plugin (PASETO v4) + Roles Plugin (RBAC) - Authentication with access/refresh tokens, registration/login/logout, and role-based access control with Super Admin/Admin/User roles
steps: Create internal/plugins/auth/plugin.go: Implement Plugin interface. Name()='auth', register routes under /auth group. Init stores config and db reference. Migrate creates users and refresh_tokens tables.

Create internal/plugins/auth/models.go: User struct (ID uuid, Email, PasswordHash, Name, Avatar, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt, LastSeenAt, IsActive bool). RefreshToken struct (ID uuid, UserID, Token string, ExpiresAt, CreatedAt). Request/Response DTOs: RegisterRequest, LoginRequest, AuthResponse (with access_token, refresh_token, user).

Create internal/plugins/auth/repository.go: UserRepository with methods CreateUser, GetUserByEmail, GetUserByID, UpdateUser, UpdateLastSeen. RefreshTokenRepository with CreateToken, GetToken, DeleteToken, DeleteUserTokens, RotateToken.

Create internal/plugins/auth/handlers.go: POST /auth/register (validate input, hash password with argon2id, create user, generate tokens, return AuthResponse). POST /auth/login (verify credentials, generate tokens, return AuthResponse). POST /auth/logout (delete refresh token). POST /auth/refresh (validate refresh token, rotate, issue new pair). GET /auth/me (return current user from context).

Create internal/plugins/auth/token.go: PASETO v4 local token generation and validation. GenerateAccessToken(userID, secret) with 15min expiry. GenerateRefreshToken() random string. ValidateAccessToken(token, secret) returning claims.

Create internal/plugins/auth/middleware.go: RequireAuth echo middleware - extract Bearer token from Authorization header, validate PASETO token, load user from DB, inject into echo.Context. Return 401 on failure with error format {"error": {"code": "AUTH_001", "message": "..."}}.

Create internal/plugins/auth/migrations/ directory with embedded SQL files: 001_create_users.up.sql (users table), 001_create_users.down.sql, 002_create_refresh_tokens.up.sql (refresh_tokens table), 002_create_refresh_tokens.down.sql. SQL must be compatible with both PostgreSQL and SQLite3 (use TEXT for UUIDs in SQLite, UUID in PostgreSQL - or just use TEXT everywhere for compatibility).
Create internal/plugins/auth/migrate.go: Embed migrations via go:embed and execute them using the DB interface.
Create internal/plugins/roles/plugin.go: Implement Plugin interface. Name()='roles', register routes under /roles group. Migrate creates roles and user_roles tables with seed data.

Create internal/plugins/roles/models.go: Role struct (ID int, Name, Description, CreatedAt). UserRole struct (UserID, RoleID, AssignedAt). Predefined constants: RoleSuperAdmin=1, RoleAdmin=2, RoleUser=3.
Create internal/plugins/roles/repository.go: RoleRepository with GetAllRoles, GetRoleByID, GetUserRoles, AssignRole, RemoveRole, HasRole.

Create internal/plugins/roles/handlers.go: GET /roles (list all roles). POST /roles/:id/assign (assign role to user - admin only, body: {user_id}). GET /users/:id/roles (get user's roles). DELETE /roles/:id/users/:user_id (remove role from user).

Create internal/plugins/roles/middleware.go: RequireRole(roles ...string) echo.MiddlewareFunc - check if user (from context, set by RequireAuth) has one of the specified roles. Return 403 on failure. This middleware must be chained AFTER RequireAuth.

Create internal/plugins/roles/migrations/: 001_create_roles.up.sql (roles table with seed data for super_admin/admin/user), 001_create_roles.down.sql, 002_create_user_roles.up.sql, 002_create_user_roles.down.sql.
Create internal/plugins/roles/migrate.go: Embed and execute role migrations.
Update internal/plugins/registry.go to import and register both auth and roles plugins.
Create ui/src/plugins/auth/api.ts: API functions for register, login, logout, refresh, getMe. All using the base API client from lib/api.ts.

Create ui/src/plugins/auth/store.ts: Auth store/context using React Context + useReducer or zustand. State: user, accessToken, refreshToken, isAuthenticated, isLoading. Actions: login, logout, refresh, setUser.
Create ui/src/plugins/auth/AuthProvider.tsx: Context provider component that wraps the app, initializes auth state from localStorage, handles automatic token refresh.
Create ui/src/routes/_guest.tsx: Guest layout with navbar (logo, navigation links, login/register buttons) and footer. Uses Outlet for child routes.
Create ui/src/routes/_guest/login.tsx: Login form with email + password inputs, submit button, link to register. On success store tokens and redirect based on role.
Create ui/src/routes/_guest/register.tsx: Register form with name, email, password, confirm password. Validation. On success redirect to login.
Create ui/src/plugins/roles/RequireRole.tsx: Component that checks user's roles and renders children only if authorized, otherwise redirects to appropriate page.
Create ui/src/plugins/roles/types.ts: Role type definitions and constants matching backend.
Ensure go build ./... passes, go vet ./... passes, cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit passes, cd ui && npm run build passes.
acceptance_criteria: cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit exits with code 0
cd ui && npm run build exits with code 0
Auth plugin registers routes POST /auth/register, /login, /logout, /refresh, GET /auth/me
PASETO v4 local tokens generated with 15min access / 7d refresh expiry
RequireAuth middleware validates tokens and injects user into context
Roles plugin creates predefined roles (super_admin, admin, user) via migration seeds
RequireRole middleware checks user roles from context
Frontend auth store manages token lifecycle with auto-refresh
Login and register pages render and compile without errors
findings: All verification commands pass: go build ./..., go vet ./..., npx tsc --noEmit, npm run build. Used npx @tanstack/router-cli generate to regenerate routeTree.gen.ts after adding new routes. The PASETO library (aidanwoods.dev/go-paseto v1.6.0) was added via go get. React 19 uses the new Context API with value prop instead of Provider/Consumer pattern. The AuthProvider uses createContext + useContext pattern. TanStack Router file-based routing with _guest prefix creates a layout route for unauthenticated pages.
